pageTitle: Public toilets and drinking water in Melbourne
metaDescription: 12,401 practical places mapped in Melbourne: 1,665 public toilets, 2,098 drinking water points, 3,334 places to park. Free on iOS and Android.
heroTitle: Public toilets and drinking water in Melbourne
heroLead: Voyager Maps has 12,401 practical places mapped in Melbourne — the things you actually need while travelling, rather than restaurants and directions.
statsIntro: How many of each kind of place the map currently holds in Melbourne. These are mapped locations, not an estimate of every one that exists — coverage comes from OpenStreetMap and grows as people add to it.
ctaBlockTitle: Find these places in Melbourne on your phone
seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in Melbourne
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In Melbourne it currently holds 1,665 public toilets and 2,098 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: 3,411 of the 12,401 places mapped in Melbourne are recorded as free of charge.
